items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: So Doc had called me on long distance phone and told me, asked me how I'm ready if I wanted to come by plane or by train.

ctx.x: Yeah. I can't think of his name.

I can't think of his name. He's a little Jewish fella. I can't think of his name right now. But anyhow we made a couple of engagements for him. We played at the Tin Angel in San Francisco. Oh yeah. We played that about three times, nine months in all. Then we played for, for Doc Dorothy at the Hangover. Yeah. Played for him a couple of times.
That was when Lizzie Miles and Joe Robertson came out there. That's right, yeah.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: So Doc called me up along the distance and asked me if I would take it.

ctx.x: I didn't remember, you see I didn't hear, I never did hear any details about that.

Yeah, well I stayed with them for six weeks at the hangover. At the hangover. Yeah, but you see my type of drumming didn't suit them any too much because I was more on the authentic side. The old style, yeah. And he wanted, Doc wanted to drum like these Dixieland drummers, so the style like Earl Hines played, you know? Well, there was no hard feelings between us because Doc had told me, he said, well, he said this thing is not definite before I went out there, you see? So I said, well, I'll take it if it's just…
Who else was in the band?

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: We played three months at the Beverly Cavern, and played three months for Doc at the Hangover in San Francisco.

ctx.x: Yes. Would that be the Parisian Room?

The Parisian Room, yeah. Yeah, the Parisian Room. Well, we played there one Saturday night, and the Almerocka Club had warned us. So, after we got through playing there was this fellow, Eddie Kidd Wolf, former friend, a dry spider, and his partner was named Frank. He was an Italian. Well, when we got through playing at the Parisian Room, we went there and finished out the night, because we knocked off at 12 o'clock at the Parisian Room. And we went there and played a couple hours until 2 o'clock in the morning.…
